description.describe_ch: 本課程分四級授課，採用多元教學活動，協助學生運用語言學習策略，討論教材之議題，以達成以下目標：培養基礎英文書寫能力，深化英語閱讀、口說、與聽力的技能，並學習理解他人觀點及感受。
description.describe_eh: The course is divided into four levels and uses a variety of teaching activities to help students apply language learning strategies, and discuss topics from their course materials in order to achieve the following learning objectives: develop basic English writing skills, deepen their English reading, speaking, and listening skills, and learn to understand the different viewpoints and feelings of others.

targets.describe_ch: 運用所學之學習策略，針對教材內容，有效地以外語表達自我想法，與他人進行溝通。
targets.describe_en: Students can apply learning strategies to effectively convey their opinions regarding the themes presented in learning materials and communicate with others effectively.

targets.describe_ch: 藉由合作式學習，了解、尊重多元觀點。
targets.describe_en: Through collaborative learning, students can understand and respect diverse perspectives.

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new_en:
1. Attendance, in-class performance, homework: 20%. This includes attendance and participation in class and homework assignments saved into the Upload folder. -2% per class hour missed. -3% per assignment missed. All homework assignments to be uploaded to the appropriate subfolder within the Upload folder on iLearn before the next class - unless otherwise stated.
 
2. Out of class reading assignments and in-class reading journals assignments: 20%. 5 journals. Read five articles, books, etc. Minimum of 500 words per reading. On Reading Journal days (see below) bring either your Windows laptop or Apple device to class to write your reading journals. See the Reading Journal Instructions for details. You’ll have 20 mins to complete the reading journal and each journal entry should be between 75-100 words in length. 
 
3. Midterm Presentation: 20%. The Midterm Presentation is to be submitted to the Upload Folder on iLearn. It must be uploaded in the following format for grading. Grading: Content 25%, Structure 25%, Visuals 25%, Performance 25%
 
Group #. Seat# Student ID
 
Example: 
7. 2 D09167536, 16 D0987654, 32 D09654321, 51 D09123456
 
Please note above that students are ordered by seat numbers. 
 
Please also note that any student work in the Upload folder is accessible to everyone in the class with the same permissions. Therefore, it is YOUR RESPONSIBILITY to make sure that you have YOUR OWN COPIES of your work saved within your own systems - and that you don’t share the only copy of any work within the Upload folder.
 
4. In-class Writing Assignment: 10%. For this assignment, you’ll be given a selection of questions based on the units covered in the textbook and will choose which one to answer. It will be done on a computer using SEB.
 
5. Final Written Exam (covering Smart Choice 5, Units 10-12): 20%.

6. Mock TOEIC Post-test / Mock TOEIC Make-up Post-test: 10%
